summary: media_search now matches EVERY word of a multi-word query, as documented — a query for «birthday card miles» no longer returns every birthday card.
details: The SQL media index combined the words of a query with OR while its own docstring said AND. Found by the new MediaObjectStore contract suite (tests/contract/test_media_object_store_contract.py), which for the first time ran the in-memory fake and the Postgres store through one suite; no offline test could see it before because each test file's inline fake invented its own search.

Test-suite standard (issue #113): three rules — where a test lives, where it gets its config, where its fakes live — written into docs/CONVENTIONS.md and tests/README.md, each with an AST gate under tests/architecture/. Seven config-acquisition patterns collapsed to two fixtures; the duplicate uncontracted memory fake (24 files) folded into the contract-bound one; new shared FakeMediaObjectStore and FakeReverseGeocoder, both under contract suites.

greenlet is now a declared dependency: SQLAlchemy's async engine needs it and SQLAlchemy's own marker skips macOS arm64, so every SQL-touching test errored on an Apple Silicon laptop. The container is Linux and was never affected.
limitations: R-A (moving the ~140 legacy files out of the tests/ root, with the container-fixture gate) is deferred and tracked on #113; the taxonomy is documented so new tests have a home.
24 inline port stand-ins remain, pinned with a reason in tests/architecture/test_port_fakes_live_in_nora_testing.py; the list can only shrink.
